title: Unit – 1 : Session – 7 : SLO – 2 | Class Design & Inheritance
sections: 1) class Vehicle { String brand; void move(){ System.out.println("moving"); } }  class Car extends Vehicle { int doors; }  class ElectricCar extends Car { int batteryKwh; void charge(){ System.out.println("charging"); } } — multilevel hierarchy Vehicle → Car → ElectricCar.

2) class Employee { String name; double salary; void work(){ System.out.println("working"); } }  class Manager extends Employee { String department; void conductMeeting(){ System.out.println("meeting"); } }  Manager m = new Manager(); m.work(); m.conductMeeting();

3) Overriding + super: class Employee { void show(){ System.out.println("Employee"); } }  class Manager extends Employee { @Override void show(){ super.show(); System.out.println("Manager"); } }  new Manager().show(); prints Employee then Manager — super.show() invokes the superclass version, letting the subclass extend rather than fully replace the parent behavior.
